name: Ramp
description: Finance and Fintech: corporate card, expense management and finance automation platform with a Developer API covering transactions, cards, users, bills and reimbursements.
access_notes: Ramp customers with Admin/Owner access create developer apps self-serve in the dashboard (Company > Developer) and get client credentials for their own account. Third-party developers must request a sandbox account (demo-api.ramp.com) and cannot connect to production; after building in sandbox they must apply for production access. OAuth authorization can only be granted by Admin/Business Owner users.
mcp_notes: Ramp ships three official MCP servers documented at docs.ramp.com: Ramp MCP (acts on account data), Developer MCP (unauthenticated docs server at mcp.ramp.com/developer/mcp), and a CLI for agent workflows. A Composio RAMP toolkit exists with 88 tools (OAuth2, not Composio-managed; bring your own OAuth app).
uncertainty_notes: Production approval applies to third-party/public integrations; a business that is already a Ramp customer with admin access has fully self-serve credentials for its own account. Token requests use HTTP Basic auth (client_id:client_secret) as part of the OAuth flows, not as a standalone API auth method.

evidence.note: Ramp uses OAuth 2.0 with scopes; client credentials and authorization code flows; authorization code is for 'third-party applications and public integrations'.
Admin access required to create a developer app; 'Third-party developer accounts cannot connect to apps in production... you can apply for production access'; sandbox at demo-api.ramp.com.
Quickstart: create app in dashboard, get token from /developer/v1/token, call Bearer-authenticated REST endpoints; 'Need a test environment? Request sandbox access.'
Webhook subscriptions via /developer/v1/webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signed payloads (X-Ramp-Signature).
'Ramp ships three MCP servers'; Developer MCP at mcp.ramp.com/developer/mcp; Ramp MCP lets Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor act on a Ramp account.
Composio RAMP toolkit: OAuth2, 88 tools, 'Composio Managed App Available? No'.
